verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents a public, versioned hosted inference API (https://inference.runanywhere.ai/v1). It publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, the endpoint is OpenAI-compatible so official OpenAI clients work, and the API reference includes a Try-it playground; the on-device SDKs also expose documented programmatic APIs. The probe's 404s were at different candidate paths, so they do not contradict the published spec at /api-reference/openapi.json. Missing for 10: an isolated test/sandbox environment or test keys, a deprecation policy or changelog, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: RunAnywhere publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for its hosted inference API ("RunAnywhere Wally Public Inference API", server https://inference.runanywhere.ai/v1)
The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so the official OpenAI clients work by pointing `base_url` at it.
The Mintlify API reference runs the "Try it" playground on the endpoint pages, generated from the OpenAPI document.
